name: ipac-caltech
description: NASA Exoplanet Archive (IPAC/Caltech). This CLI queries confirmed exoplanets, TESS TOI candidates, table schemas and archive statistics through the public TAP/ADQL API. It also checks whether an object name resolves and reads system overview pages.

commands.name: run-tap-query
commands.summary: Run an arbitrary ADQL query against the archive's TAP service (tables: ps, pscomppars, toi, cumulative, stellarhosts, k2pandc, ...) and return JSON rows

params.name: query
params.description: ADQL query, e.g. "select top 10 pl_name,hostname from pscomppars where disc_year=2024 order by pl_rade desc". Use plain WHERE clauses; avoid contains(point,circle) cone searches, which may be blocked.
params.example: select top 10 pl_name,hostname,pl_orbper,pl_rade,disc_year from pscomppars where disc_year=2024 order by pl_rade desc

params.name: maxrec
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return (an alternative to 'select top N')

example.query: select top 10 pl_name,hostname,pl_orbper,pl_rade,disc_year from pscomppars where disc_year=2024 order by pl_rade desc

commands.name: export-tap-csv
commands.summary: Run an ADQL query against the TAP service and return the result as CSV text (for bulk export)

params.name: query
params.description: ADQL query, e.g. "select toi,tid,tfopwg_disp,pl_orbper,pl_rade from toi where tfopwg_disp='PC' order by toi"
params.example: select toi,tid,tfopwg_disp,pl_orbper,pl_rade from toi where tfopwg_disp='PC' order by toi

params.name: maxrec
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return

example.query: select toi,tid,tfopwg_disp,pl_orbper,pl_rade from toi where tfopwg_disp='PC' order by toi

commands.name: list-planets-by-year
commands.summary: List confirmed planets discovered in a given year (Planetary Systems Composite table), sorted by a chosen column, top N

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Number of planets to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: sort
params.description: Column to sort by (pl_rade = radius in Earth radii, pl_orbper = orbital period in days, pl_bmasse = mass in Earth masses)

commands.name: list-host-planets
commands.summary: List all confirmed planets orbiting a given host star, with period, radius, mass and discovery method

params.name: hostname
params.description: Exact host star name as used by the archive, e.g. Kepler-186, TRAPPIST-1

commands.name: list-toi-candidates
commands.summary: List TESS Objects of Interest (TOI) filtered by TFOPWG disposition, ordered by TOI number

params.name: disposition
params.description: TFOPWG disposition: PC = planet candidate, APC = ambiguous PC, CP = confirmed planet, KP = known planet, FP = false positive, FA = false alarm

params.name: maxrec
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return

commands.name: list-tap-tables
commands.summary: List all tables available through the TAP service, with descriptions

commands.name: get-table-columns
commands.summary: Get the column schema (name, datatype, description) of a TAP table such as pscomppars, ps or toi

params.name: table
params.description: TAP table name, e.g. pscomppars, ps, toi, cumulative, stellarhosts

commands.name: check-object-name
commands.summary: Check whether an object/system name resolves in the archive inventory; stat OK means /overview/<name> exists

params.name: locstr
params.description: Object/system name, e.g. Kepler-186 or TRAPPIST-1

commands.name: get-system-overview
commands.summary: Get the planets shown on a system's overview page (planet name, radius in Jupiter radii, confirmed/candidate status)

params.name: name
params.description: System/host name, e.g. Kepler-186 or TRAPPIST-1

commands.name: get-archive-statistics
commands.summary: Get the archive's statistics page rows (confirmed planet counts by discovery method, mass/radius coverage, radius bins, Kepler/TESS candidate counts)

commands.name: get-toi-counts
commands.summary: Get current TESS TOI totals from ExoFOP: total count, latest new/updated dates and counts, and counts per TFOPWG disposition

notes: TAP (/TAP/sync) is the main data interface. It takes ADQL: SELECT <cols> FROM <table> WHERE <constraints>. Use 'select top N' or maxrec to limit rows. There is no paginated listing.

Useful tables: pscomppars (one row per confirmed planet, composite parameters), ps (all parameter sets; filter default_flag=1 for defaults), toi (TESS candidates), cumulative (Kepler KOIs), stellarhosts.
Common columns: pl_name, hostname, pl_orbper (days), pl_rade (Earth radii), pl_bmasse (Earth masses), pl_eqt (K), discoverymethod, disc_year, sy_dist (pc). Use get-table-columns to discover more.
Use plain ADQL WHERE clauses. Cloudflare's WAF blocked queries using contains(point(...),circle(...)) cone searches.
String literals in ADQL use single quotes. Name filters in list-host-planets are exact matches; use run-tap-query with "hostname like 'Kepler-%'" for wildcard matches.
robots.txt disallows /cgi-bin/TblView/nph-tblView, /cgi-bin/ExoOverview, /cgi-bin/nstedAPI and /cgi-bin/Lookup/nph-aliaslookup.py. The legacy nstedAPI is retired in favour of TAP.
No login is needed; all commands are public reads.
